stdout: I found all three call sites to `InventoryService::save` (two in `src/main.cpp`, one in `src/service/order_service.cpp` where `OrderService::save` delegates to `inventory_.save`) and added `std::cerr << "[log] inventory save\n";` immediately before each, adding `<iostream>` to `main.cpp`. Note: `orders.save(p1)` in `main.cpp` calls `OrderService::save`, not `InventoryService::save` directly, so it wasn't logged there — its internal `inventory_.save` call is already covered in `order_service.cpp`.
